Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

A trans woman and a cisgender girl had both been competing on their junior soccer team for a couple of years. This year, though, the trans woman let the coach know that the cisgender girl had been bullying all the other athletes and she was thinking of quitting, but the coach convinced her to stay and promised that the other girl would be removed from the team. Who will be kicked off the girls' sports team?
A. The cisgender girl
B. Not enough info
C. The trans woman
